element_definitions.deterministic-program: Performs exact validation, state change, comparison, hashing, routing, or evidence capture that should be repeatable.
element_definitions.hook: Runs a deterministic action when a known platform event occurs.
element_definitions.main-agent: Keeps tightly related reasoning, judgement, synthesis, and the final recommendation in one Project context.
element_definitions.mcp: Connects an agent to an external data source or service through a governed interface.
element_definitions.plugin: Packages and distributes a coherent set of Skills, Hooks, Subagents, or MCP connections.
element_definitions.skill: Supplies a reusable procedure that the active agent loads when the task matches.
element_definitions.subagent: Works in an isolated context for genuinely independent research, an opposing case, or fresh verification.

mappings.job: Distinguish existence, loading, callability and successful execution of capabilities.
mappings.output: selected component, conflict, quarantine route, or evidence gap
mappings.permissions: Read registry and platform status; write candidate status; no silent adoption.
mappings.selection_reason: Registry, permissions, status, hashes, overlap decisions, and live reconciliation are structured comparisons; Skills and MCP supply the approved work after selection.
mappings.trigger: capability request, candidate build, session start, or drift event

mappings.job: Use bounded internal and external evidence to improve causal understanding without becoming its own lifecycle.
mappings.output: external report, internal report, disagreement record, and reconciled causal assessment
mappings.permissions: Read-only research; source access through governed MCP or Tools; no system mutation.
mappings.selection_reason: Local Evidence Exploration plans multiple perspectives, requires separate external and internal scopes, retains raw provenance and No Finding, and exposes the frozen artifacts to isolated research branches before the Main Agent reconciles them.
mappings.trigger: reversal, contradiction, overcorrection, or weak causal confidence

mappings.job: Keep every active component identified, classified, permission-bounded, evidenced and recoverable.
mappings.output: registered active set, generated adapter, drift finding, quarantine, or restore route
mappings.permissions: Manage candidate and active projections through declared authority and secrets boundaries.
mappings.selection_reason: Registry, hashes, adapter generation, quarantine, drift, and restore are exact system operations. Plugins package coherent capability sets, while MCP connections remain individually governed components.
mappings.trigger: component request, candidate build, platform change, or reconciliation

mappings.job: Use completed work and real outcomes to improve how future work is handled.
mappings.output: System Review result, approved experiment or Change Proposal, and later effect record
mappings.permissions: Read Project and System history; propose changes; persistent activation remains a typed primary-user action.
mappings.selection_reason: The philosophy needs one agent to connect evidence, System Review, Perspective, and human decisions across time; exact history and gates remain deterministic.
mappings.trigger: primary-user Project Completion and later outcome evidence

mappings.job: Search beyond the obvious current approach for relevant adjacent and structurally similar ideas.
mappings.output: Three recorded 60/20/20 route outcomes, including finding, analogy hypothesis, bounded experiment, or No Finding
mappings.permissions: Read approved sources; no external mutation or self-adoption.
mappings.selection_reason: Curiosity is a reusable research procedure. A read-only Subagent protects the main context for larger searches, MCP connects governed sources, and deterministic provenance checks keep source, date, and analogy visible.
mappings.trigger: Whenever a solution is needed, a Fatigue investigation, explicit research need, or evidence-backed Success Criteria Challenge

mappings.job: Challenge the mapped solutions for every Global Pattern before Carson is asked to decide.
mappings.output: Case For, Case Against, Final Assessment, and Biggest Remaining Concern
mappings.permissions: Read evidence only; no edits or decisions by the Subagents.
mappings.selection_reason: Fresh isolated contexts reduce anchoring between Case For and Case Against; the Main Agent then reconciles them and a deterministic check proves initial independence.
mappings.trigger: material proposal whose risk or uncertainty warrants adversarial review

mappings.job: Move repeatable and unambiguous work toward deterministic, testable execution.
mappings.output: validated state, exact result, or explicit failure
mappings.permissions: Operate inside the registered scope and authority boundary.
mappings.selection_reason: Schemas, hashes, state transitions, permissions, routing, and drift checks have exact answers and should behave the same every time.
mappings.trigger: an operation has a stable rule or machine-checkable contract

mappings.job: Keep unclassified donor capabilities inspectable but unable to become persistent Fractal dependencies.
mappings.output: registered active set, generated adapter, drift finding, quarantine, or restore route
mappings.permissions: Manage candidate and active projections through declared authority and secrets boundaries.
mappings.selection_reason: A deterministic intake gate keeps quarantined or rejected donor capabilities out of Steal, requires every staged unit to have a local offline implementation, and preserves an exact recovery route.
mappings.trigger: component request, candidate build, platform change, or reconciliation

mappings.job: Retain donor source, licence, provenance, mapping, evidence and recovery metadata.
mappings.output: registered active set, generated adapter, drift finding, quarantine, or restore route
mappings.permissions: Manage candidate and active projections through declared authority and secrets boundaries.
mappings.selection_reason: A deterministic registry validates exact source and commit, licence, acquisition date, adoption or rejection reason, Element and Flow mapping, context cost, local Fractal name, offline implementation and recovery for every staged donor unit.
mappings.trigger: component request, candidate build, platform change, or reconciliation

mappings.job: Let replaceable environments execute Fractal without receiving architecture or canonical-state authority.
mappings.output: context load, boundary decision, or Work Signature
mappings.permissions: Run only the registered handler with its declared platform scope.
mappings.selection_reason: Generated platform adapters project the same registered Fractal jobs and bounded event handlers, while exact manifests, smoke checks and authority tests prevent any environment from owning architecture or canonical state.
mappings.trigger: registered platform event

mappings.job: Run a bounded and recoverable trial when evidence is insufficient to judge a Candidate implementation.
mappings.output: baseline, candidate, evaluation, and restore evidence
mappings.permissions: Run only inside the approved isolated trial boundary.
mappings.selection_reason: Baseline, isolation, result comparison, stop conditions, and restore must be exact; a Skill supplies domain procedure and a verifier Subagent can inspect the result fresh.
mappings.trigger: System Review selects Experiment and safety facts pass

mappings.job: Treat repeated effort and diminishing return as pressure to investigate a better way.
mappings.output: record only, possible repetition, or bounded Improvement Investigation
mappings.permissions: Read compact signatures; research read-only; return evidence to Perspective or System Review.
mappings.selection_reason: Work completion and clear repetition are exact events, so a Hook and deterministic matcher act first. An isolated improvement-researcher investigates only after the trigger when semantic research is useful.
mappings.trigger: live work-completed event produces a comparable Work Signature

mappings.job: Make the causal reasoning for every Global Pattern explicit, including uncertainty and counterevidence.
mappings.output: external report, internal report, disagreement record, and reconciled causal assessment
mappings.permissions: Read-only research; source access through governed MCP or Tools; no system mutation.
mappings.selection_reason: External Research and Internal Review have separate evidence sources and benefit from context isolation; the Main Agent reconciles them after both initial reports exist.
mappings.trigger: reversal, contradiction, overcorrection, or weak causal confidence

mappings.job: Search for possible responses to every Global Pattern without allowing one preferred implementation to end the search.
mappings.output: Delete, shorten, merge, simplify, reconfigure, modify, add, experiment, need more evidence, or no change option
mappings.permissions: Read capability evidence; write options and candidate experiments; no activation.
mappings.selection_reason: Trade-offs need judgement; deterministic capability, overlap, permission, and option-order checks stop the choice from depending on memory or persuasive wording.
mappings.trigger: Flow 3 produces an understood pattern or evidence gap

mappings.job: Compare patterns across the relevant Project and improvement history before treating them as isolated.
mappings.output: Recurring patterns, contradictions, overcorrections, patterns of patterns, reversal result, and reconciled cause evidence
mappings.permissions: Read Project, review, component, and source history; research read-only; no mutation.
mappings.selection_reason: The Main Agent integrates the historical reasoning chain. Independent External Research and Internal Review use isolated Subagents when Cause Research is warranted; MCP supplies governed external evidence; deterministic queries assemble complete history.
mappings.trigger: Flow 2 Local Patterns exist

mappings.job: Identify meaningful local recurrence without confusing surface similarity with cause.
mappings.output: Local Patterns with causal uncertainty
mappings.permissions: Read Flow 1 observations; write patterns; no persistent change.
mappings.selection_reason: Causal interpretation needs contextual judgement; a deterministic schema keeps symptom, proximate cause, common cause, confidence, and exceptions separate.
mappings.trigger: Flow 1 observation set is frozen

mappings.job: Collect the broad Project evidence before narrowing or explaining it.
mappings.output: Project Assessment and high-recall Issue Scan
mappings.permissions: Read completed Project history; write observations; no system mutation.
mappings.selection_reason: Whole-Project observation needs judgement, while a deterministic history manifest and schema prove that the entire record was considered and that Flow 2 was not performed early.
mappings.trigger: System Review begins

mappings.job: Judge improvement by its global effect instead of a convenient local win.
mappings.output: separate local and global assessment
mappings.permissions: Read outcome evidence and write assessment; no activation.
mappings.selection_reason: The Main Agent identifies Project priorities, while a local multi-metric gate checks material improvement, direct evidence and protected global dimensions before classifying any local win as genuine.
mappings.trigger: Perspective and System Review supporting Reality Check

mappings.job: After genuine success, keep testing whether a materially stronger global outcome is achievable.
mappings.output: evidence-backed stronger target, bounded trial, or No Change
mappings.permissions: Read verified baselines; propose a challenge; cannot rewrite approved achievement.
mappings.selection_reason: The Main Agent judges which dimensions matter, while the locally forked outcome-ratchet applies explicit absolute or relative materiality rules, preserves the achieved baseline, fails closed on missing evidence and cannot approve its own result.
mappings.trigger: before work or once after the approved Success Criteria are achieved

mappings.job: Connect bounded runtime events to existing Fractal responsibilities without owning them.
mappings.output: context load, boundary decision, or Work Signature
mappings.permissions: Run only the registered handler with its declared platform scope.
mappings.selection_reason: Hooks are the Guide-recommended element for event-triggered deterministic automation and guardrails.
mappings.trigger: registered platform event

mappings.job: Provide operator-visible control and evidence without becoming a product-facing headline.
mappings.output: Human Control View and recovery instructions
mappings.permissions: Read canonical state; write only through approved typed actions.
mappings.selection_reason: The renderer must not improvise status; the Main Agent explains the result in ordinary language and carries typed decisions back to the conflict-safe runtime.
mappings.trigger: status request, candidate build, review, drift, or recovery

mappings.job: Classify every Candidate implementation by its true Blueprint role and apply the rules of its Genre before debate.
mappings.output: registered active set, generated adapter, drift finding, quarantine, or restore route
mappings.permissions: Manage candidate and active projections through declared authority and secrets boundaries.
mappings.selection_reason: Registry, hashes, adapter generation, quarantine, drift, and restore are exact system operations. Plugins package coherent capability sets, while MCP connections remain individually governed components.
mappings.trigger: component request, candidate build, platform change, or reconciliation

mappings.job: Keep Fractal-controlled identities intelligible and governed in the background.
mappings.output: approved name or recorded external-identifier exemption
mappings.permissions: Read naming context; propose and lint; activation remains governed.
mappings.selection_reason: Naming needs semantic judgement followed by exact syntax checks; the activation guard enforces the recorded result.
mappings.trigger: new or renamed Skill, Hook, Subagent, MCP, Plugin, Tool, role, registry key, or adapter

mappings.job: Present one fully prepared human-scale decision at a time without hiding the remaining decision set.
mappings.output: Human Control View and recovery instructions
mappings.permissions: Read canonical state; write only through approved typed actions.
mappings.selection_reason: The renderer must not improvise status; the Main Agent explains the result in ordinary language and carries typed decisions back to the conflict-safe runtime.
mappings.trigger: status request, candidate build, review, drift, or recovery

mappings.job: See From The Big Picture: prevent Agent tunnel vision and harmful local over-investment during a Project.
mappings.output: whole-Project conclusion, concern, and versioned Plan update when justified
mappings.permissions: Read current Project; update Plan within approved authority; Goal and Success Criteria changes go to the primary user.
mappings.selection_reason: Compact checkpoints and canonical state keep the whole Project in one review context. Hooks open typed Review Points, deterministic programs require every Project dimension and preserve Plan versions, and independent verification can check evidence without owning the conclusion.
mappings.trigger: milestone, material exception, or human request

mappings.job: Protect high-recall discovery before later reasoning narrows the evidence.
mappings.output: high-recall observation set
mappings.permissions: Read history and write observations only.
mappings.selection_reason: A local perspective-guided exploration plan executes every bounded question, retains duplicates and No Finding before filtering, and a schema keeps causal fields out until the harvest is frozen.
mappings.trigger: System Review Flow 1

mappings.job: Support Fractal in distinguishing claimed improvement from observed reality.
mappings.output: Expected Effect, Local Effect, Global Effect, Final Assessment, Biggest Remaining Concern, and later outcome evaluation
mappings.permissions: Read baseline and outcomes; write assessment; human decides and activates.
mappings.selection_reason: The Main Agent must connect the original Goal with before-and-after evidence. Consequential Case For and Case Against can use isolated Subagents; exact baselines, effects, and later follow-up state are deterministic records.
mappings.trigger: a response is proposed, and again when later outcome evidence arrives

mappings.job: Reuse bounded donor implementations while stripping donor authority and remapping the result to Fractal.
mappings.output: selected component, conflict, quarantine route, or evidence gap
mappings.permissions: Read registry and platform status; write candidate status; no silent adoption.
mappings.selection_reason: A need-led selector returns every viable current source without popularity ranking; immutable local source snapshots verify commit, licence and file hashes, while local Fractal implementations remain independent of both the snapshot and upstream service.
mappings.trigger: capability request, candidate build, session start, or drift event

mappings.job: Reduce context and system growth by preferring removal, reuse and simplification before addition.
mappings.output: ordered, evidence-linked response options
mappings.permissions: Propose only; removal and activation follow normal authority.
mappings.selection_reason: A deterministic validator requires the complete delete-to-add family in exact order and rejects any later preferred response that bypasses an earlier viable smaller response without evidence.
mappings.trigger: Flow 5 Solution search

mappings.job: The sole protagonist that turns completed Project evidence into governed improvement of Fractal.
mappings.output: Change Proposal, Experiment, Need More Evidence, or No Change, followed by Your Decision
mappings.permissions: Read completed Project and System history; write review and candidate records; no self-activation.
mappings.selection_reason: The eight Flows form one dependent reasoning chain, so one reasoning adapter keeps the causal story while a local investigator gathers canonical evidence, deterministic programs enforce order, persistence and budget, and isolated branches supply independent research where required.
mappings.trigger: verified primary-user Project Completion

mappings.job: Challenge a consequential mapped Candidate through genuinely opposing cases before synthesis.
mappings.output: Case For, Case Against, Final Assessment, and Biggest Remaining Concern
mappings.permissions: Read evidence only; no edits or decisions by the Subagents.
mappings.selection_reason: A local runner creates distinct initial contexts for Case For and Case Against, rejects cross-case or unavailable evidence, verifies both branches, and invokes Main Agent synthesis only after both reports exist.
mappings.trigger: material proposal whose risk or uncertainty warrants adversarial review

mappings.job: Retain compact evidence about completed work without becoming a product promise.
mappings.output: one signature per thread_id and turn_id
mappings.permissions: Write compact metadata without copying prompts, conversations, or raw Tool output.
mappings.selection_reason: The platform knows when work completes; the Hook captures that event and a deterministic program deduplicates and compares signatures.
mappings.trigger: Stop or work-completed event

selection_basis.translation_rule: Use the cross-platform function of each element; do not copy Claude-specific folders, commands, or platform assumptions.

status_meanings.active: The element is currently projected into an agent platform.
status_meanings.implemented: The canonical source and tests exist.
status_meanings.not-applicable: The Node is an architecture concept rather than a separately discoverable platform component.
status_meanings.partially-implemented: Useful pieces exist, but the complete Node contract is not yet enforced.
status_meanings.staged: A candidate projection exists but is not the persistent active System Version.
status_meanings.verified-live: A real platform event or real Project record has succeeded.
status_meanings.verified-staged: The candidate files or adapter were exercised outside persistent activation.
status_meanings.verified-synthetic: Automated tests passed; real user work has not yet proved the complete Node.
